text: Create a Linux machine via the console, API, or CLI
quote: You can create a Linux machine using the Paperspace console, Paperspace API, or Paperspace CLI.

text: Go from signup to training a model in seconds
quote: Go from signup to training a model in seconds

text: SSH into your VM with your own key and get full root access
quote: Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access.

text: Save custom machine configurations as templates to spin up new machines
quote: Custom templates are templates of your machines and their configurations. You can use these custom templates to create new machines with your specifications.

text: Shared drives provide storage accessible from multiple machines on a private network
quote: Shared drives provide storage that is accessible from multiple machines in a private network.

text: Auto-shutdown stops a machine after a configurable period of inactivity (1hr–1wk)
quote: The auto-shutdown feature places your machine in a stop state after a predefined period of inactivity, which can range from one hour to one week.

text: API keys allow programmatic access via a JavaScript SDK
quote: API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).

text: Notebooks provide a web-based Jupyter IDE with shared persistent storage backed by accelerated compute
quote: Notebooks are a web-based Jupyter IDE with shared persistent storage for long-term development and inter-notebook collaboration, backed by accelerated compute.

text: Deployments let you run container images and serve ML models as a managed service
quote: Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.

text: Workflows let you script GPU-backed ML pipelines with a few lines of code
quote: Workflows automate machine learning tasks, combining GPU instances with an expressive syntax to generate production-ready machine learning pipelines with a few lines of code.

text: Access the largest GPU catalog including NVIDIA Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs
quote: Choose from the largest GPU catalog in the world. Leverage the latest NVIDIA GPUs including Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs.

text: 'ML in a Box' template comes preinstalled with major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers
quote: Choose "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with all the major ML frameworks and CUDA® drivers.

text: Save up to 70% on compute costs versus major clouds or self-hosting
quote: Save up to 70% on compute costs

text: Machines come with persistent storage, GPU options, and free unlimited bandwidth for HPC workloads
quote: Machines are Linux and Windows virtual machines with persistent storage, GPU options, and free unlimited bandwidth.

text: High-end machine types like NVIDIA H100 require requesting approval before use
quote: There are several machine types grouped by CPU, GPU, and multi-GPU. If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.

text: NVLink can be enabled to boost GPU-to-GPU data transfer speed for HPC tasks
quote: Enhance data transfer speeds and scalability between NVIDIA GPUs for high-performance computing tasks by enabling NVLink.

text: Manage Paperspace resources programmatically via a RESTful HTTP API
quote: Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests.

text: Official Paperspace command-line interface (CLI) is available for installation and use
quote: Install and use the new Paperspace Command Line Interface.

text: When creating a machine, configure type, OS/template, disk size, region, auth, and network features like public IP or private network
quote: When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template, disk size, region, authentication, starting state, and which features (like backups, public IP address, or private network) to enable or add.

text: Change instance types anytime and cancel anytime without long-term commitment
quote: Easily change instance types anytime so you always have access to the mix of cost and performance. Cancel anytime.

text: Low-cost GPUs billed per second, only while running
quote: Low-cost GPUs with per-second billing. Save up to 70% on compute costs
